lines.en: I stride across the badlands
Red dirt kicks up behind me
My feathers look like dry grass
My neck bobs as I walk
I go around the sparse trees
I am not quick, but my steps are long
My feet have only three toes
Gravel sounds under me
I head for the shrubs
I sway forward
I look about as I go
The wind pushes at my feathers
I stop and let my legs recover
I walk up the dirt slope
My long shadow trails on the ground
I crush a small heap of red dirt
I stride over a gully
I watch the insects on the ground
I stand in the middle of the badlands
I look left and right

lines.zh: 风吹得我胸口的毛乱翘
lines.en: The wind ruffles my chest feathers
Nothing else is nearby
I rest one foot raised
My eyes are searching for movement
A sound rises in my throat
This place is very dry

lines.zh: 风把红土吹进我的羽毛。
lines.en: Wind blows red dust into my feathers.
I do not like to hide

lines.zh: 红土上没什么，我把脖子放下。
lines.en: Nothing on the red dirt; I lower my neck.

lines.zh: 风吹得我胸口的毛乱翘。
lines.en: The wind ruffles the feathers on my chest.
You happen to block my way
I am taller than you think
I do not like being approached

lines.zh: 我侧过头用一只眼看你。
lines.en: I tilt my head and look with one eye.
You can kick, and so can I
I tilt my long neck at you
You are blocking those shrubs

lines.zh: 我的羽毛看起来软，其实不
lines.en: My feathers look soft, they are not
You had better move
I do not chase people, but I do shove
I step back
I sway my long neck
A few feathers fell out
My long legs stumble.
I lift a foot to kick

lines.zh: 我张开长脖子嘶了一声。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and hiss.
This wound does not stop me

lines.zh: 我盯着你的方向，疏林恶地的草太干。
lines.en: I stare your way; the wooded badlands grass is dry.
I do not run, I stand
Try again and I kick

lines.zh: 我下的蛋，得架在火上煮。
lines.en: My eggs must be cooked over a fire.
I will not eat what you hold
Put it on the ground, let me look
I do not know this smell
You hold it too close
I do not run after things

lines.zh: 我啄了啄你掌心的种子。
lines.en: I peck the seeds in your palm.

lines.zh: 我下的蛋，能放进熔炉煮。
lines.en: The eggs I lay can be cooked in a furnace.
Lower it and I will look
This is not what I eat
You hit my long leg
My chest bumps your leg.
That knocked me off balance
I kicked you with one foot
My dust rubbed off on you
I ruffle my feathers and take half a step.
I am sturdier than you
I shake my feathers
That is not a fight
Next time I use my feet
There are few of us in the badlands
I see a shape in the distance
I know the tall-necked one
We walk around each other
I hop twice around my mate.

lines.zh: 我们一起看着同一片灌木
lines.en: We look at the same shrubs
No need to call, just walk over
Later it went north
I did not follow
This stretch is enough for two

lines.zh: 我又低头啄了一下，是蛋壳。
lines.en: I peck again — eggshell.
I cannot bite this

lines.zh: 我用脚趾拨了拨，红土被踢起。
lines.en: My toes flick it, kicking up red earth.
Too small, I cannot see it
I roll the egg under me with my beak.
I do not pick these up
I flip it with my bill

lines.zh: 掉在地上的我一般都吃
lines.en: I usually eat what falls on the ground
This is too hard, I give up
I kick it aside
Something moved on the red dirt
I have raised my neck

lines.zh: 恶地的红土，我先踩一脚。
lines.en: Badlands red dirt, I stamp it first.
I fix on that spot
I do not like this thing
My feet are set
One step covers that distance
It is smaller than it looks
I have seen it clearly
In the wooded badlands, I lay eggs.
I stamp toward it step by step
I am not fast, I am tall
My legs can kick far
It retreated behind the shrubs
I go around the thorn bush
The wind blows dirt in my face
It has started to run
I do not chase, I walk straight
A few steps more
Badland emu eggs can be cooked.

lines.zh: 我的三趾脚踹在你膝上。
lines.en: My three-toed foot kicks your knee.
My legs are long, the kick reaches
That landed on you

lines.zh: 恶地里下的蛋，能烤着吃。
lines.en: An egg laid in the badlands can be cooked.
I did not use my bill, I used my feet
The kick pushed you back a few steps
My foot comes down and I stand
That was not fierce enough
Gravel sprays up
I lift my foot and stomp.
I stand on the red dirt
This badlands is wide open

lines.zh: 我从恶地的灌木后走出来。
lines.en: I step out from the badland brush.
Shrubs here, good
The wind comes and I hold my ground
I walk a stretch, then stop
I look left and right
Only I am here
I lift one leg

lines.zh: 远处的红土一直延到天边
lines.en: The red dirt runs to the horizon
Fire caught my feathers and stank

lines.zh: 我摔在红土上，灰都飞了
lines.en: I land on red dirt and dust flies
I am a poor swimmer, I sink
The blast shoves me backward

lines.zh: 飞来的东西插进我羽毛里
lines.en: Something flying sticks in my feathers

lines.zh: 那股力把我推得退了步
lines.en: That force pushed me back a step

lines.zh: 恶地里东西少，我越来越轻
lines.en: Little to eat here, I grow light

lines.zh: 雷落在红土上，我吓了一跳
lines.en: Lightning struck the dirt and startled me

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地面可以站
lines.en: No ground to stand on in the void
